description: Show, for 1 to 25 products, the exact body the Google Merchant push would send for each one — title, description, link, image links, price, availability, identifiers and custom labels — or the reason it would be held back (blocker: no_url, no_title, no_price, no_image, no_translation, not_shoppable, no_feed_label). It walks the same collect step and the same builder as the real push, so it cannot differ from what Google would receive. Local and read-only: no Google call, nothing is sent or stored, and it needs no arming. A product that is not an active, unpaused member of the Google channel is listed in notOnChannel (set_channel_membership adds it). Returns { adapterId, adapterName, feedLabel, currency, contentLanguage, items, notOnChannel }. Use check_channel_readiness for the whole channel's blockers and push_google_merchant_catalog to actually send; fix a blocker with update_product, upsert_product_prices or upsert_product_translation and preview again.

adapterId.description: The Google Merchant connection id from list_marketplaces / get_marketplace. Omit it when the workspace has exactly one connection; with several, omitting it is refused and names them.

productIds.description: The products to preview, at most 25 ids from search_products.

items.description: A product id returned by search_products.

name: preview_google_merchant_products
title: Preview Google Merchant products
